name: Minimal
description: 注重内容与留白的极简主题，浅色页脚包含品牌简介、导航、联系方式与独立版权栏，适合设计公司和创意工作室
description_en: A content-first minimalist theme with generous whitespace and a light footer featuring brand details, navigation, contacts and a separate legal row. Ideal for design agencies and creative studios.
